Name: Refined Alex - Seasonal Edition
Author: Crisaius
Description:
This mod is a personal refinement project focused on Alex, combining original edits with assets based on and inspired by [i][b]Seasonal Cute Characters[/b][/i] by [b]Poltergeister[/b] and the vanilla game.
The goal is to keep Alex recognizable while improving balance, consistency, and expression across seasons and events.

[b][img]https://imgur.com/P4gmhQX.png[/img]﻿

[/b] • Refined portraits and character sprites for Alex across all seasons and festivals.
• Designed as an extension for [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][/i].
• Vanilla-friendly style with balanced colors and clean readability.
• Optional [b]Alternative Eyes[/b] for portraits, configurable in-game.
• Optional nose overlay toggle for character sprites.
• Fully configurable via Content Patcher.

[img]https://imgur.com/zeLF08G.png[/img]

[b][color=#e69138]1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[color=#e69138][b]3[/b][/color]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][b] [/b](required).
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Extract this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.
[b][color=#e69138]5[/color][/b]. Run the game using SMAPI.

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/kQkaEbs.png[/img]

This mod can be configured using [b]Content Patcher[/b].
Available options:

[list]
[*][b]Enable Refined Alex[/b]
Enables or disables all Refined Alex portraits and character sprites.[/*]
[*][b]Alternative Eyes[/b]
Switches portrait eye style between the default and alternative version.[/*]
[*][b]Alternative Winter Outfit[/b]
Switches Alex’s winter outfit assignments (portraits and sprites). The blue varsity style becomes the standard winter look, while the red hooded winter jacket is used for the Festival of Ice.[/*]
[*][b]Hide Noses[/b]
Toggles the nose overlay on character sprites.[/*]
[/list]Configuration can be edited via [b]config.json[/b] or with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b] (if installed).

[img]https://imgur.com/g03zHCI.png[/img]

Special thanks to [b]Poltergeister[/b], creator of [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][/i], for allowing the use of their assets and for providing the foundation that inspired this project.
Thanks to [b]AirynS[/b], creator of [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url][/i], whose work inspired some of the portrait designs.
Additional thanks to [b]Seyph[/b], whose Spirit’s Eve mask design served as inspiration for Alex’s mask in this mod.

All authors are credited in detail in the Credits section below.
